title: Energy Conversions
seo_title: Grade 4 Energy Conversion Worksheets: Devices That Change Energy
standard_text: Apply scientific ideas to design, test, and refine a device that converts energy from one form to another.
meta_desc: Free Grade 4 science worksheets on energy conversions (NGSS 4-PS3-4): electric energy into light, sound, heat and motion, solar panels and generators, energy chains and designing a solar oven. 100 practice questions with answers.
key_big: Devices change energy from one form into another.
key_sub: A lamp changes electric energy into light. A solar panel changes light into electric energy. No device makes energy from nothing.
body_html:
How to think about it

Many devices convert (change) energy from one form to another. A device does not make energy from nothing. It changes the energy that goes into it.

  • Lamp: electric energy → light
  • Fan: electric energy → motion
  • Speaker: electric energy → sound
  • Toaster: electric energy → heat
  • Solar panel: light → electric energy
  • Wind turbine: motion → electric energy

Most devices also give off some energy we do not need, like the heat from a light bulb. Engineers design devices to meet criteria (what it must do) within constraints (limits like cost and materials).

Example

What energy change happens in a hair dryer?

Electric energy goes in.

Heat comes out, and the fan moves air.

Answer: electric energy → heat (and motion and sound)

Example

A solar panel runs a fan. Show the energy changes.

light → electric energy

electric energy → motion

Answer: light → electric energy → motion

Common mistakes

  • Thinking a device makes energy from nothing.
  • Mixing up the input and the output: a solar panel takes in light; it does not make light.
  • Forgetting that devices also give off unwanted heat or sound.

faq.a: It is when energy changes from one form to another, like electric energy into light in a lamp.

faq.q: What energy change happens in a solar panel?
